title: 第八章 抢功德？假道长遇真高人
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
不用想也知道是谁的手笔。

    手机铃声响起，是特助林砚，“傅总，虚白大师已经请到，您现在在哪儿？”

    “你们先去江边，我稍后就到。”傅烬川的声音没什么温度，挂了电话，指尖在屏幕上点了几下，拨通另一个号码。

    电话接通，他语气平淡隐含冷意：“抱歉姑姑，让您失望了，有一份礼物您很快就能收到。”

    天色彻底暗下来，姜无念还在找人，距离江边几十米，熟悉的腥臭味就飘了过来，比往常更浓。

    不对劲，

    不对劲。

    姜无念心里浮现出一个不好的念头，有人要跟他抢功德！

    她三步并作两步飞奔过去，果然在江边看见个穿着道袍的白毛老头。

    这老头面前还非常专业地摆了个缚灵阵，什么桃木剑，招魂铃，八卦镜堆了到处都是。

    手里捏着好几张黄符，闭着眼睛，念念有词，正是被傅烬川请来的虚白大师。

    王素仪浮在江面，她双目通红，周身环绕的鬼气浓得发黑，整个江面都被染得暗沉。

    姜无念“啧啧”两声，找了个隐蔽的角落蹲下，从口袋里摸出刚顺的煎饼吃起来，饶有兴致地看着眼前这场斗法。

    看得出来这老头确实是有点本事，可惜也只是“有点”而已，摆出来的花架子比真本事多。

    她没着急出去，就当看个热闹，主要是想看看到底是个怎么样的货色，敢来跟她抢功德。

    一番作法，虚白大师黄符撒得一地都是，法器换了一件又一件，看着声势浩大，其实不过是靠繁多的法器唬住了王素仪。

    被对方不断挑衅，王素仪有些发怒，猛地嘶叫一声，一团浓稠的鬼气顿时将虚白包裹了起来，快速升空。

    耳边传来虚白撕心裂肺的叫喊声，姜无念嫌弃地撇了撇嘴。

    哪个山门教出来的，真是丢死人了，被师父知道，非把他逐出师门不可。

    嚼完最后一口煎饼，姜无念拍了拍手上的碎屑，慢悠悠地站起身。
content_en:
You don't have to think twice to know whose handiwork it is.

    The phone rang, and it was Special Assistant Lin Yan, "Mr. Fu, Master Xubai has been invited. Where are you now?"

    "You guys go to the river first, I'll be there later." Fu Jinchuan's voice had no warmth. He hung up the phone, tapped the screen a few times with his fingertips, and dialed another number.

    When the call was connected, his tone was calm and cold: "I'm sorry, aunt, to disappoint you. There is a gift you will receive soon."

    The sky was completely dark, and Jiang Wunian was still looking for someone. A few dozen meters away from the riverside, a familiar fishy smell wafted over, stronger than usual.

    Something's wrong,

    Something is wrong.

    A bad thought came to Jiang Wu Nian's mind. Someone was trying to steal his merits!

    She ran over in three steps and two steps at a time, and sure enough she saw an old man with white hair wearing Taoist robes by the river.

    The old man even set up a spirit-binding array very professionally in front of him, with peach wood swords, soul-summoning bells, and Bagua mirrors piled everywhere.

    Holding several yellow talismans in his hand, closing his eyes and muttering something, it was none other than Master Xubai invited by Fu Jinchuan.

    Wang Suyi floated on the river, her eyes were red, and the ghost energy surrounding her was so thick that the entire river surface was dyed dark.

    Jiang Wu Nian "tsk tsk" twice, found a hidden corner and squatted down, took out the Gangshun pancakes from his pocket and ate them, watching the fight in front of him with great interest.

    It can be seen that this old man does have some ability, but unfortunately it is only "a little bit". He puts on more showmanship than his real ability.

    She was not in a hurry to go out, she just wanted to watch the fun, mainly because she wanted to see what kind of thing she was, and how dare she come to compete with her for merit.

    After doing this, Master Xubai's yellow talismans were scattered all over the floor, and the magical weapons were changed one after another. Although it seemed that the momentum was huge, in fact, it was just relying on the large number of magical weapons to frighten Wang Suyi.

    Being constantly provoked by the opponent, Wang Suyi became a little angry and screamed suddenly. A thick ghostly aura immediately enveloped Xubai and quickly rose into the air.

    Xu Bai's heart-rending shouts reached his ears, and Jiang Wu Nian curled his lips in disgust.

    It was really embarrassing for him to be taught by some monastic disciple. If the master knew about it, he would have to be expelled from the school.

    After chewing the last bite of pancake, Jiang Wu Nian patted the crumbs on his hands and stood up slowly.
title_en: Chapter 8: Stealing merit? A fake Taoist meets a true master
